purpose: Judge the BETSE-order emulator with general-network ion channels (validation/betse/network_world_adapter.py, emulator/network.py; BETSE's F and R, BETSE's Ca-ATPase) on the plain-BETSE cases parity-rung2-4-20261109-01/betse-reference/p4-kleak-dense (network channel K_Leak, KLeak, max Dm 6e-18 m^2/s) and p4-kv1p5-kleak-dense (Kv, Kv1p5, max Dm 1e-15 m^2/s, then K_Leak), on the rung-1 mammal default world; it must agree to roundoff. Tooling check, not an engine model; same tolerances as emulator-default-world-mammal-dense.
notes: matched_constants_or_cpu_gpu: the emulator with BETSE's constants against BETSE, or one Cells result against another of the same case (CPU vs GPU). codata_constants is reported for reference only.
Relative errors divide by |BETSE value|; a zero reference value admits only exact agreement.
SIM starts from BETSE's init_final.npz unless the run record says sim_start = chained.
Observables whose own change over a phase does not exceed the tolerance are reported as flat (non-discriminating).
